# The Terminal Cathedral

> The website of Dan Almer Jensen, tech polymath in Copenhagen, Denmark: trained electronics technician and Hardware Design Engineer. The interactive homepage is presented as a fictional archive terminal; the records below are factual.

## Records

- [Dan Almer Jensen](https://terminalcathedral.com/records/dan-almer-jensen/): background and profiles
- [AI Madpakken and the Human Sandwich Model](https://terminalcathedral.com/records/ai-madpakken/): an openly licensed (CC BY 4.0) written workflow for work with AI, where AI explores (COULD), a human decides (SHOULD) and an executor reports (DID). Not software.
- [Theme Park World on Windows 11](https://terminalcathedral.com/records/theme-park-world/): an unofficial beta wrapper mod. It needs a copy of the game that already starts, and was tested on one PC.
- [Album Zero and Album One](https://terminalcathedral.com/records/the-terminal-cathedral/): AI-assisted synthwave concept albums made with Suno and Suno Studio
- [Field note 001](https://terminalcathedral.com/records/field-note-theme-park-world/): how the Theme Park World wrapper works
